name: Black Rock Tavern and Restaurant

items: Tender mixed greens, housemade citrus vinaigrette, toasted cashews, creamy gorgonzola and seasonal fruit

sections.name: Mains
items: Al dente penne pasta in a rich tomato cream sauce, vodka and topped with fresh herbs and shaved aged parmesan. Side of garlic bread

Stir fried rice, sweet pineapple, peppers, cabbage and carrots in a teriyaki sauce with sweet chili glaze, scallions and toasted cashews

items: Absolute Peppar, house made lemonade, watermelon puree, shaken and served over ice in a pint.

Elijah Craig Bourbon, Carpano Antica Formula Vermouth, and chocolate bitters.

sections.name: Black Rock Mocktails
items: Refreshing lemonade shaken with any of our fruit purees, topped with soda water. Choose strawberry, blackberry, raspberry, watermelon, peach, or mango.

360 Vanilla Vodka, Kahlua, and fresh espresso, shaken until frothy. Add Bailey’s, $1.

items: Apple cider, house brewed iced tea, and a dash of pumpkin puree, shaken over ice and sprinkled with cinnamon.
